conditions.clock: clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); failed calls are counted, not timed, and make a case invalid
conditions.corpus: <public-sets>/jpeg (34 files; SHA-256 list: expected.txt); <public-sets>/zune-jpeg (8 files; SHA-256 list: SHA256SUMS); <public-sets>/google-venice (9 files; SHA-256 list: SHA256SUMS)
conditions.cpu_timing: libjpeg-turbo, ImageIO and VideoToolbox 1-thread cases: the same rule, calling thread at user-interactive QoS
conditions.gpu_warmup: 1.0 s of the same work before each timed case, then 15 timed calls, median; no discarded iterations
conditions.reference_decode: TurboRef tr_decode: libjpeg-turbo's libjpeg API, JDCT_ISLOW, do_fancy_upsampling TRUE, JCS_RGB (as the corpus test); Y plane: the same with JCS_GRAYSCALE
conditions.reference_encode: TurboRef tr_encode: libjpeg API, quality 95, the file's sampling factors, JDCT_ISLOW, standard Huffman tables
